data.text:
Implement simulator state snapshot/restore functionality

Requirements:
- Capture full CPU state: all GPRs, PC, HI/LO, pipeline registers (f2d, d2e, e2m, m2w), stall flags, forwarding flags
- Capture data memory contents
- Capture instruction memory (or at least the loaded program)
- Save to/load from file (JSON or binary format)
- Integrate with debug engine: save/load commands in REPL debugger and JSON-RPC API
- Add CLI flag to auto-save state on program completion (useful for comparing with HW simulation output)
- Support suspend/resume: load a snapshot and continue execution from that point

Use cases:
1. Debug suspend/resume: save state mid-execution, reload later to continue debugging
2. HW comparison: save final state after sim completes, compare with HW simulation output
3. Regression: save known-good state, compare against future runs
